name: ShadowFormat
description: Represents shadow formatting for a shape.
example:
Set myDocument = ActivePresentation.Slides(1)

With myDocument.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, _
        50, 50, 100, 200).Shadow

    .ForeColor.RGB = RGB(0, 0, 128)
    .OffsetX = 5
    .OffsetY = -3
    .Transparency = 0.5
    .Visible = True

End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the four-character creator code for the application in which the specified object was created. For example, if the object was created in Microsoft PowerPoint, this property returns the hexadecimal number 50575054. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: ForeColor
properties.description: Returns or sets a ColorFormat object that represents the foreground color for the fill, line, or shadow. Read/write.

properties.name: Obscured
properties.description: Determines whether the shadow of the specified shape appears filled in and is obscured by the shape. Read/write.

properties.name: OffsetX
properties.description: Returns or sets the horizontal offset of the shadow from the specified shape, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: OffsetY
properties.description: Returns or sets the vertical offset of the shadow from the specified shape, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: Transparency
properties.description: Returns or sets the degree of transparency of the specified fill, shadow, or line as a value between 0.0 (opaque) and 1.0 (clear). Read/write.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Represents the type of shadow. Read/write.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets the visibility of the specified object or the formatting applied to the specified object. Read/write.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Returns or sets the shadow style. Read/write.

properties.name: Blur
properties.description: Returns or sets the blur radius of the specified shadow, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: Size
properties.description: Returns or sets the size of the specified shadow as a percentage of the shape size, from 0 to 200. Read/write.

properties.name: RotateWithShape
properties.description: Returns or sets whether the specified shadow rotates when the shape it is associated with rotates. Read/write.

methods.name: IncrementOffsetX
methods.description: Changes the horizontal offset of the shadow by the specified number of points.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how far the shadow offset is to be moved horizontally, in points. A positive value moves the shadow to the right; a negative value moves it to the left.

methods.name: IncrementOffsetY
methods.description: Changes the vertical offset of the shadow by the specified number of points.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how far the shadow offset is to be moved vertically, in points. A positive value moves the shadow down; a negative value moves it up.
